description: Mechanism control no_warmup for any Hoffer study (any loss, Cars196 k=16 or In-Shop k=2), defined exactly like the no_warmup variant of Hoffer on Cars196 (configs/ablations/phase2/cars_cir_controls/hoffer_cir.json: ssl_config.warmup_epochs 0, evaluation embeddings on the GPU), plus the Phase-2 standard of 1000 epochs as a ceiling and patience 20 (the Cars196 Hoffer runs inherited the studies' 600). Makes the Phase-2 grid symmetric: Hoffer on In-Shop, SLADE on Cars196 and In-Shop. Where the tuned warm-up is already 0 (In-Shop Circle and Proxy-Anchor) the variant equals the tuned configuration.
name: no_warmup_rest_hoffer
